description: Main-text Fig. 5d (= Fig. 1e for M1) for the six fabricated masks: fraction of the light incident on the cell that reaches sites q1-q4 at the detector plane of the use condition (the four sum to the throughput), design simulation and measurement (median and 16-84 % range): the measured site fractions times the measured throughput; M1 measured under the untilted NA 0.30 cone, M2-M6 under tilted cones, with the iris set for the chief-ray angle of each design (10 deg for M2 and M3, 20 deg for M4-M6). Fig. 5e: equivalent exposure gain of M1 over the CFA against the scene illuminance, simulated. exposure_gain_points: the marked values of M1 at 5 and 20 lux, simulated and from the measured routing (median and 16-84 % range). Scene illuminance in lux: an 18% grey scene imaged at f/1.8 (lens transmission 0.9), 1/30 s, 3000 K blackbody, one exposure per point, read noise 1.5 e- rms; one lux puts 1.07 e- into the on-axis green site of the CFA. CFA = measured spectral sensitivities of a smartphone image sensor, green peak scaled to 0.90.
